{"baseRefName":"main","body":"### Independent arithmetic controls at `2b23fd3c`

Adds 13 bounded exact-rational fixtures shared by host controls and the actual CUDA kernel test (28 total kernel cases). Integer-grid vertices and independently certified final float rounding cover known parabolas, guard boundaries, sub-ULP corrections, stored float scaling and map-quantization error separately. Production source and numerical gates are unchanged.

Local focused Release CTest 4/4 PASS; ordinary host replay 13/13 PASS; float-denominator, early-store and wrong-scale alterations are rejected at named witnesses. UBSan and focused collection/fail-closed checks PASS. [Exact commands, source hashes and limits](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/blob/2b23fd3cebcab116240ece1566fb7f3510423a25/docs/post_rc0/issue257/arithmetic-control/README.md). The full local collection validator fails because unrelated executables were not built; this is not a full-suite pass. Expanded CUDA compilation/native execution is UNRUN locally; [current-head CI](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/actions/runs/39765561343) **PASS**: CPU CTest 78/78 including all four PeakFitArithmetic controls, known-motion/smoke checks and CUDA compile-only. Historical native results below retain their original source. No S1 solution, downstream science or performance qualification is claimed.

---

Fixes #257. CUDA evaluates the five selected float CCF samples and the parabola vertex in double, multiplies by the unchanged float CCF scale in double, then rounds once on storing the float candidate. Integer selection, the strict `1e-15f` threshold/fallback, convergence and interfaces stay unchanged; correcting a rounded-zero denominator intentionally changes some old guard decisions.

Native Release validation on 4GPUs: **CPU 74/74, CUDA 110/110, CUDA+nvCOMP 113/113**, no skips. The actual production kernel passes 15 same-map cases; its compiled float-denominator mutant fails the captured pedestal witness (normal exit 1). CPU/CUDA known-motion aggregates pass, retaining the noisy characterization failure. The legacy Tier A fixture exact gate fails, but frozen-F and this branch's CPU outputs are exact matches on the same fixture; no gate was relaxed.

Evidence: [`docs/post_rc0/issue257/README.md`](docs/post_rc0/issue257/README.md), with 76 hash-verified raw records and source/commands/exits/resources. Independent of #254; combined full-census attribution is evidence-only PR #261. Production performance cost, S1 closure and downstream scientific qualification remain unrun. No merge by this agent.

Reviewed the production hunk and `tests/cuda_peak_fit.cu` at `d888ab11`, alongside the retained #257 native evidence and the new #261 census. No new native GPU execution in this review.

The implementation promotes the five stored samples before the curvature calculation, retains the float threshold value, applies the existing float scale in double, and performs the final float store once. Integer selection and tie order are unchanged. The actual-kernel test and named float-denominator mutant support a genuine, localized arithmetic correction; the intended rounded-zero guard changes are now documented. I found no additional blocking production defect in this focused diff.

**Do not judge this patch by reproducing CPU movie outputs.** The useful contract is accurate evaluation of the specified parabola on the same stored samples, with an explicit fallback rule and error bounded at the final float conversion. A small exact-rational or higher-precision reference for selected finite float triplets, plus constructed parabolas with known vertices, would strengthen independence beyond copying the same expression into host double. Keep map-quantization error separate from fitting error: more precision cannot recover information already absent from the float CCF.

The complete #261 census changes the causal conclusion: #254-only to #254+this fit gives 17→19/60 fixed-reference screen positives and median maximum global discrepancy 0.038605→0.039105 px in the other 58 configurations. Thus the hypothesis that this is the main missing cause of the remaining global gap was not supported by that experiment. This does **not** negate the same-input arithmetic bug or establish worse scientific accuracy. Retain the fix's independent mathematical justification; do not advertise it as the S1 solution.

The existing known-motion results are useful bounded regression evidence: the high-SNR global/local/nonsquare gate cases pass, but the noisy case still has a visible characterization accuracy failure. `OVERALL PASS` must not be presented as low-SNR motion recovery or downstream qualification. The next #262 work should expand truth/conditioning coverage, not tune this patch until legacy CPU outputs match.

Performance remains unmeasured: expect the selective double calculation to be relatively small, but measure the real kernel and complete movie on target hardware rather than asserting zero/negligible cost. Preserve the legacy fixture failure and frozen-F identity control separately.
